title: Number of Home Caregiving Grant Applicants and Top Conditions Cared for by Applicants
what_it_is: Number of Home Caregiving Grant Applicants and Top Conditions Cared for by Applicants

sections.label: HCG applicant age breakdown
sections.summary: Of HCG applicants, 74% were 70 and above, with smaller shares in younger age bands, and MOH does not collect their specific conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Of which, 74% were aged 70 and above, 15% were aged 60 to 69, 5% were aged 50 to 59, 2% were aged 40 to 49, and 1% were aged 30 to 39, at the point of application.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health does not collect information on the specific conditions of HCG applicants.

sections.label: Recipients unable to perform ADLs
sections.summary: The recipients are those who are unable to perform the ADLs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The recipients are those who are unable to perform the ADLs.

sections.label: ADL criteria for HCG eligibility
sections.summary: Caregivers of those with autism, intellectual disability or mental health conditions satisfy HCG requirements if they cannot perform the ADLs.

sentences.text: When the Member asked the question about the caregivers of those with autism or intellectual disability, as well as those with mental health conditions, actually, if they meet the criteria of not being able to perform the ADLs, they will satisfy the requirement of HCG.

sections.label: HCG requirements and intended purpose
sections.summary: HCG has certain requirements and is intended to help those with the most or greater needs regarding ADLs.

sentences.text: I want to assure the Member that, at the moment, yes, HCG has certain requirements.
It is meant and intended to help those with the most or greater needs with regard to ADLs.

sections.label: Permanent ADL inability and doctor certification
sections.summary: A care recipient permanently unable to perform daily activities, certified by a doctor, would be eligible to apply, and such cases could be surfaced for streamlining.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The description of what the ADLs are, is quite clear.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, if, let us say, the care recipient is not able to perform those daily activities permanently and the doctor certifies that he or she is not able to do so, then they would be eligible to apply for this.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In those cases, perhaps that could be surfaced to us and we will see where we could streamline that a bit better.
